verdicts.quote: If a partial payment reduces the outstanding amount from 100 USD to 40 USD before initiation, the attempted message states 40 USD.

verdicts.missing: Whether a customer-level do-not-contact or paused state applies, and whether a billing reminder is exempt from a marketing opt-out, is not decided.

verdicts.quote: Overlapping runs, repeated triggers, redeployment, account toggles, due-date edits, retries, and recipient changes cannot produce a second accepted submission for the same billing account, invoice, and offset.

For each attempt, a payment, state change, account pause, due-date edit, suppression or opt-out change, or recipient correction effective before submission initiation is reflected in the eligibility check.
After explicit temporary nonacceptance, the service retries automatically when the window is open and otherwise eligible, the retry delay has elapsed, and an attempt remains.
verdicts.missing: Retry policy and outage handling are defined (C-52, C-53, C-11), but no escalation or notification to a person when sending keeps failing; failures are only visible in history/status.

verdicts.quote: When the external service reports throttling, the operator sees delayed or expired work under the normal window policy. A provider-specified retry time is honored.
verdicts.missing: The provider's rate limit is unconfirmed and no pacing of a large batch within it is specified, only reactive throttling handling and earliest-first priority (C-48).

verdicts.quote: only windows whose opening is at or after T qualify during that enabled interval. A window that opened before T is skipped even if its 24 hours have yet to elapse.
the first window opens at 09:00 UTC on 2026-11-21 regardless of daylight saving changes or viewer location.

verdicts.missing: How the amount and currency are formatted for the recipient (locale, symbol, decimals) is explicitly left open.

verdicts.quote: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, suppressed following a known permanent delivery failure, and explicitly opted-out destinations each produce zero new submissions.
A submission has exactly one recipient, the address currently designated by the billing record for this invoice. There are zero CC or BCC recipients and zero fallback recipients.
Each visible window shows the invoice reference, scheduled instant, offset, current outcome, time of that outcome, and submission attempt count.
The email provides the issuing business identity, the displayed invoice reference, the current due date, the amount still collectible, and its currency.
verdicts.missing: A way to pay is not required (C-79 only says 'If a reminder includes a link'), and whether any link expires is not stated.

verdicts.quote: A caller with permission to manage reminders for account A can read or alter A’s reminder setting. The same permission confers no access to B’s setting.
After a deliberate deployment stop takes effect, open pending, blocked, and retry-scheduled windows show canceled.
verdicts.missing: Global stop, per-billing-account pause and no manual resend (C-102) are stated, but per-customer opt-out control and any preview or dry-run are not addressed.

verdicts.quote: Before an eligible upcoming window opens, its pending outcome has an attempt count of zero. After it opens, the status reflects blocked, submitting, retry scheduled, or its eventual outcome
permits submission starting at 09:00 UTC on 2026-11-21 up to but excluding 09:00 UTC on 2026-11-22.
